summary: Frontend regression testing of DVR page after the useEffect exhaustive-deps fix. DVR loads, auto-selects first segment, segment click updates Playback, search filter works, seg-length + retention toasts work. Regression confirmed on camera-filter behavior: when the filter excludes the currently-selected segment, the Playback panel does NOT switch to a segment in the filtered set — it retains the stale selection (see RCA). Smoke tests on Dashboard, Sentinel AI (grounded Gemini answer received), and Event Log passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Camera filter regression: after switching camera filter to a camera that does NOT contain the currently-selected segment, the Playback panel keeps showing the previously-selected (now filtered-out) segment. Header still shows 'Front Porch' while Segments list shows only Backyard (1). Requirement was 'previously-selected segment retained if still present, otherwise selection updates'.

action_items: Fix DVR.jsx line 21 auto-select logic. Current: setSelected((cur) => cur || (s.length ? s[0] : cur)). This never updates once set, so filter changes leak a stale selection. Replace with membership-aware update, e.g.: setSelected((cur) => (cur && s.some(x => x.id === cur.id)) ? cur : (s.length ? s[0] : null));
critical_code_review_comments: DVR.jsx: The functional updater setSelected((cur) => cur || (s.length ? s[0] : cur)) satisfies the exhaustive-deps lint but breaks selection-follows-filter behavior. Must check whether cur is still in filtered list s.
DVR.jsx: When s is empty after a filter/search, selection is not cleared to null — the Playback panel still shows the old segment though 'NO SEGMENTS' would be more appropriate.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 DVR checks pass; camera-filter selection retention fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only the DVR camera-filter selection sync path needs re-verification. Reproduce by: load /dvr, wait for first Front Porch segment auto-selected, choose 'Backyard' in dvr-camera-filter, then confirm Playback header + summary switch to the Backyard segment (not the stale Front Porch one). Sentinel AI takes ~15-20s for Gemini reply, plan waits accordingly.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the exhaustive-deps fix replaced the previous unconditional setSelected(s[0]) with setSelected((cur) => cur || (s.length ? s[0] : cur)). This updater only assigns when cur is falsy, so once a segment is selected on initial load, subsequent filter/search changes never reassign selection even if the previous segment is filtered out. Reproduction: navigate to /dvr (Front Porch segment auto-selected) -> pick 'Backyard' in dvr-camera-filter -> Segments list shows only the single Backyard segment, but the Playback panel and header still show the Front Porch segment. Mitigation: change to membership-aware updater as noted in action_items.
